name: Kollu Rasam
steps: Soak horse gram, then cook it with plenty of water until tender; reserve the earthy cooking broth and mash a little of the gram.
Crush pepper, cumin and garlic together and extract the tamarind in warm water.
Simmer tomato with tamarind, turmeric and salt until softened; add horse-gram broth, mashed gram and crushed spices.
Heat until the rasam foams, then finish with mustard, red chilli and curry leaves crackled in oil.
tips: Save the horse-gram cooking liquid: it gives this rasam its characteristic deep flavor.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
